描述_EN: according to the artist, the two shards of colour/light, one white, one red have been inserted into this deep black space to add visual tension. guru nanak was the founder of the sikh religion and the first of the ten sikh gurus. they convey ascension from the level of earth to a higher consciousness. surrounding him are lined details in blue and white, these trace an abstract map and reflect the many journeys that he made during his lifetime not only around the india, but also beyond, to afghanistan, iraq, china and tibet. the stark black background draws attention to the contemplative expression on his face and the prayer beads in his hands. in this painting the artist has depicted nanak in a minimal, organic form.
描述_ZN: 根据艺术家的说法，两个颜色/光的碎片，一个白色，一个红色被插入这个深黑色的空间，以增加视觉张力。 古鲁-纳纳克是锡克教的创始人，也是锡克教十位大师中的第一位。 它们传达了从地球层面到更高意识的升华。 围绕着他的是蓝白相间的细节，这些细节描绘了一幅抽象的地图，反映了他一生中的许多旅程，不仅是在印度，而且是在阿富汗、伊拉克、中国和西藏的旅程。 鲜明的黑色背景使人注意到他脸上沉思的表情和他手中的祈祷珠。 在这幅画中，艺术家以一种最小的、有机的形式描绘了Nanak。
